opennyai_summary.3_November_2025__decision:
The offences alleged against the petitioner are punishable under Sections 363, 366, 366A(1)(i), 376(2)(n) and 376(3) of the IPC and Sections 4(2) r/w 3(a)(b)(c)(d), 6 r/w Section 5(l) and 8 r/w Section 7 of the POCSO Act.
As per order dated 01.03.2023, the learned Special Judge granted bail to the petitioner in Crime No.991/2022 of Chengannur Police station.
While granting bail, the Court imposed the following conditions:
2025:KER:82885 "
1. The petitioner/1st accused shall be released on bail on executing bond for Rs.50,000/ with two solvent sureties each for the like sum.
2. The petitioner shall appear before the Investigating Officer as and when directed.
3. The petitioner shall not make any attempt, either directly or through any person or means, to communicate with the victim or her parents in any manner.
4. The petitioner shall not intimidate or influence the witnesses in this case.
5. The petitioner shall not involve in any offence, while on bail."
5.
9. Having regard to the nature of the allegations and the conduct of the petitioner after the grant of bail, I feel that he is not entitled to be released on bail at this stage.
Therefore, the Bail Application stands dismissed.
opennyai_summary.3_November_2025__facts:
Subsequently, another FIR was registered against the petitioner on 29.07.2024 alleging offences under Sections 332(c) and 74 of the BNS by the Nooranadu Police.
The Investigating Officer submitted a report before the Court.
The learned Special Judge cancelled his bail on the ground that he committed the offences under Sections 332(c) and 74 of the BNS in violation of the conditions afore mentioned.
opennyai_summary.arguments:
The learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that subsequent crime was registered after a year, and the binding effect of the conditions will not extend throughout the trial.
7. The learned Public Prosecutor submitted that the petitioner 2025:KER:82885 is also accused in Crime No.20/2018, wherein the offences alleged are punishable under Sections 363, 366A, 376(II)
and 354A(1) r/w Section 34 of the IPC and also under Sections 4, 5(l)(r) read with section 6, 7 r/w Section 8 of the POCSO Act.
8. The learned Public Prosecutor opposed the bail plea of the petitioner and submitted that the release of the petitioner would adversely affect the trial.
It is submitted that the petitioner is not entitled to be released on bail.
